facts.title: Summertime Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 pound strawberries, hulled and thinly sliced
1 heaping tablespoon fresh, chopped basil or mint
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a medium serving bowl, combine the strawberries, peaches, blueberries and basil. Drizzle the lemon juice, maple syrup and balsamic vinegar on top. Gently toss to combine.
Serve immediately, or chill for later. This salad is best enjoyed promptly, but will keep well for about 2 days in the refrigerator (pour off excess juices if necessary).

notes: Make it vegan: Be sure to use maple syrup, not honey.
facts.summary: This simple fruit salad recipe is fresh and healthy! It features strawberries, peaches and blueberries with a little balsamic vinegar and basil. It’s a delicious side dish or dessert (for dessert, you can serve it as is or add some whipped cream to make it more decadent). Recipe yields 6 side servings.
